title: Read-only SQLite open cannot recover a hot WAL
body: Opening a WAL-mode SQLite database with a read-only connection fails with "unable to open database file" while another process (the dev server) holds the write connection. Open read-write when inspecting a live app database from a test process.

title: next dev rewrites generated files and breaks stash pops
body: Running next dev regenerates app/next-env.d.ts and appends a nextjs-agent-rules block to app/AGENTS.md. Any git stash taken afterwards can fail to pop silently against those files; restore next-env.d.ts to HEAD and keep the AGENTS.md block committed. Check git stash list after every stash round-trip.

title: Ghost classnames render unstyled pages that still pass functional QA
body: When a stylesheet is rewritten to a new design language, existing pages keep compiling with the old class vocabulary — dead classnames render as unstyled DOM while every functional test, content check, and route test still passes. A screenshot review will not catch it: vision-model reviewers are charitable toward flat layouts. Verify presentation by grepping the stylesheet for each class a page references (or asserting computed styles in browser QA) before calling a surface styled.

title: Journey suite drifts silently when it is not part of the unit-test gate
body: The Playwright journey suite (pnpm test:e2e) asserts UI copy and locators but is NOT part of pnpm test — every copy or markup change to a surfaced page silently breaks it. Two failures compounded: the anchor-test sweep grepped only *.test.ts (missing e2e/*.spec.ts), and one spec seeded data under the pre-scope-key convention, so it had been red since an earlier shipped fix. For any user-facing copy/markup change: sweep e2e/*.spec.ts for the changed strings and run pnpm test:e2e in-loop.

title: Catalog lived only in untracked SQLite; runtime seeding is new work, not a freebie
body: A versioned JSON seed file proves nothing about runtime: if the only DB writer is an admin workflow, fresh clones get an empty catalog. When replacing an ingestion pipeline, add and test the idempotent seeder (hash-guarded, additive) before deleting the old writer, and pin the export source dataset explicitly.

title: Loop tooling parses only the canonical Status form
body: Spec/plan status lines must be **Status:** Approved (colon inside the bold). Writing **Status**: Approved silently fails every engine guard with a misleading "no Status line found" error, and mid-loop prettier or doc edits to plan.md trip the scheduled-baseline hash — recover via the documented cohort reset/init/approve-plan/schedule sequence, never engine reset.
